messages.text: I approve these exact assignments. The new information improves the expected civilian return without altering the repair we already owe. Keep Trade and fund Repair; do not treat Lantern's Council assignment alone as satisfying that condition. I still request Guard, using offered Vigil without a simultaneous Warrant. A margin against unforeseen losses is worth more to me than leaving an available garrison idle.

reason: The disclosure supports our plan but does not change my choice. Prepared Beacon three protects the contract through the public rule, while the additional distribution effect remains a conditional report until resolution. Our second contract and route recovery no longer appear opposed to civilian welfare. Lantern's existing pledge remains binding independently of this final assent.
